placement.title: English placement test
placement.subtitle: 20 questions • about 10 minutes • instant result and course recommendation — free.
placement.introText: Answer without help for an accurate result. If you don't know an answer, choose “I don't know” instead of guessing.

levelDesc.A1: Beginner — you understand and use very simple phrases. Start with a foundation course.
levelDesc.A2: Elementary — you communicate in simple everyday situations. Next step: conversation & grammar.
levelDesc.B1: Intermediate — you handle most everyday situations. Ready to build fluency or prepare for exams.
levelDesc.B2: Upper-intermediate — you speak with reasonable fluency. Great for IELTS or Business English.
levelDesc.C1: Advanced — you use English flexibly and effectively. Focus on mastery and international exams.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Abnauona Courses — the courses & training arm of Abnaona Institute Abroad in Ajman.
about.relationText: Abnaona Institute Abroad was founded to serve Egyptian and Arab expat families in the UAE. With the trust of thousands of families, we launched Abnauona Courses to offer language and skills courses for the whole family — in-person and online — with the same quality and commitment.
about.visionText: To be the leading platform for language and skills learning for Arab expat communities, connecting them to their identity and opening doors to the future.
about.missionText: Deliver high-quality education at fair prices and flexible times, through certified trainers, modern curricula and verified certificates.
